title: Slushie Bar Xtra Citrus Burst 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Slushie Bar Xtra Citrus Burst delivers a bright, sunny blend of vibrant citrus flavours, combining zesty Lemon, sharp Lime, and juicy Orange into one bold vape. This e-liquid packs a punch of tangy, refreshing flavour, with each inhale bursting with sweet citrus tang, making it an excellent choice for vapers who enjoy a lively, fruit-filled vape. Whether you're after a zingy citrus kick or a smooth, flavourful vape, Citrus Burst is sure to satisfy. Crafted with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Slushie Bar Xtra Nic Salts are designed for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) vape kits and pod systems. Each e-liquid in the collection provides smooth throat hits and rapid nicotine relief, making them ideal for those seeking a satisfying alternative to traditional tobacco. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, these e-liquids are perfect for all-day vaping with a flavour-packed experience waiting in every puff.
